name: Shizuku
source:
[b]A door of madness is opening creakily...[/b]

The last few days have flown by as if I were floating in a bizarre, viscous sands of time. I had a peculiar delusion that every day the same time was repeating with the same pictures. It has been a string of tedious days with no signs of change for the better. Before long, I realized that all of the sounds and colors were leaving my dull world. I had given up on my uninteresting reality and was gradually stepping towards the world of madness...

And when one day, a girl in my class went insane. She sprang up straight from her seat, as if she were a machine, and abruptly began shouting obscenities. At the time when the teacher held her mouth, her face had become covered in blood from fresh wounds. It was the girl's own nails that were digging into her skin. While the rest of the class gasped at the scene, I just stared at the fresh blood, feeling that the real world was regaining its color...

After classes, one of the teachers in the school, my uncle, asked me to investigate this matter. So now I am starting the investigation with the assistance of one of the girls who has a connection to the case.

[i]Little do I know, to which horrors it will lead...[/i]

[Edited and complemented from the [url=https://leaf.aquaplus.jp/product/sizuku/]official website[/url]]
translation:
[b]一扇疯狂之门正在吱呀作响地打开……[/b]

过去几天飞逝而过，仿佛我漂浮在一种奇异而粘稠的时间流沙中。我产生了一种奇特的错觉，觉得每天都有相同的画面在同一时间重复。这是一连串乏味的日子，没有任何好转的迹象。不久之后，我意识到所有的声音和色彩都在离开我沉闷的世界。我已放弃了无趣的现实，正一步步踏入疯狂的世界……

直到某天，班上一个女孩发疯了。她像机器一样从座位上弹起来，突然开始大声喊叫污言秽语。当老师捂住她的嘴时，她的脸已被鲜血覆盖——是她自己的指甲在抠挖皮肤。班上其他人都为这一幕倒吸凉气，而我只是盯着那新鲜的鲜血，感到现实世界正在恢复它的色彩……

放学后，学校里的一位老师——我的叔叔——要求我调查此事。于是，我在一位与案件有关联的女孩的协助下，开始了调查。

[i]殊不知，这将把我引向何等恐怖……[/i]
